known_information: Fixed exogenous scenario clocks known to agents, current simulated queues/onboard states and past residual seats; not a validated real-time forecast. V8 clocks are inferred, not official published timetables.
unverified_parameters: Legacy tastes, hazards, walking and grade mappings remain prototype assumptions. Effective release lag is retrospectively calibrated on reused SNU queue constraints; not identified actual building egress.
forecast_seat_interpretation: One indivisible marginal person is queried AFTER the ordinary weighted FIFO forecast of people ahead. No rounding of pre-queue seats; no accumulation of fractions across departures. Physical weighted demand, capacity and actual boarding unchanged. Not a probability guarantee.
wait_discomfort_interpretation: Prospective increment G(A+W)-G(A) of cumulative journey waiting. Completed wait A affects marginal discomfort, never physical ETA. Same polynomial scales as V12; uncalibrated alternative hypothesis. No reset by walking to another queue.
random_utility_interpretation: Retain V12 fixed individual coefficients plus event-specific iid errors. rho=1 sensitivity was inferior in Tuesday pilot; no empirical serial correlation estimate.
initial_assignment_interpretation: Preserve the inherited scenario mode/first-stop mixture. No uncalibrated re-optimization of every departure. Dynamic queue/boarding/walking choices remain enabled; source mixture is not an observed modal split.
fallback_crowding_interpretation: Known retained onboard plus this chosen vehicle known FIFO-ahead boardings plus marginal person. Historical reserved capacity is diagnostic only, never imputed as observed passengers. Entry-load proxy held over inherited ride, not full future load trajectory. Categorical grade costs unchanged.
walking_variation_interpretation: Restore inherited relative person-specific factors from frozen prepared.walk_scales, on top of the retained nominal4.8km/h path-local physics. No new speed distribution or random draws. Factors and nominal speed are scenarios, not SNU measurements.
cohort_release_interpretation: Retrospective global scaling of inherited unmeasured class-end-to-building-departure lag; same class, location, destination and mass; no departures before class end. Parameter chosen with already used reports, not independently validated actual egress behavior.
calibration_status: Only the global effective release-lag scale is retrospectively fit to reused constraints; whole model not independently validated.
committed_arrivals_information: Simulation information assumption: already-started approach intent and readiness known to predictor; excludes future departures, later rerouting and realized future queue. Not measured student tracking.
later_walking_preference: Repeated-change terminal-walk probability retained for accessible destinations; far SNU walkers use transit/gate fallback. Personal patience and denial experience govern opportunities.
repeat_walk_interpretation: User-directed terminal walk probability p_n=1-(1-p_reference)^(2^n), conditional on an actual decision opportunity. Reference neutralizes only incremental count-dependent changing-action fee. Same current distance/wait/cost context; probability, not physical ETA. Not estimated from observed students.
scenario_scope: User-reported behavioral hypotheses; patience dispersion and short enroute encounter window are unmeasured scenarios.20min is a diagnostic, not forced abandonment. Source modal cohorts, destination and mass retained; far initial SNU walk redirected to a city-bus strategy.
seat_forecast_interpretation: Retain inherited causal past residual-seat proxy and actual denied-boarding experience. This is a subjective model assumption, not measured numeric onboard occupancy.
